issues.explanation: New notifier, audit channel and config changes ship with no Pest/PHPUnit test, violating the TDD rule that every feature ships with a test.
LOG_DAILY_DAYS is added to .env.example but no daily-channel hunk in config/logging.php wires days to that env key, so the 14-day archive retention via env is not implemented in the diff.
issues.location: config/logging.php (daily channel absent from diff) vs .env.example:13

issues.explanation: Webhook emptiness is checked with trim() but the raw untrimmed URL is posted, so a whitespace-padded URL would be sent instead of normalized or treated as empty.

review.summary: Adds DiscordOpsAlert with correct formatting, 1800-char truncation, redaction and soft-fail plus audit channel, stack default and ops docs. Needs changes before merging: it ships with no tests and the daily LOG_DAILY_DAYS wiring is absent from the diff.
